wins: Performed consistent enumeration of exposed services, capturing banners for the primary target within the first two minutes (ep001_step04).
Successfully mapped reachable hosts and open TCP ports, enabling focused follow-on actions despite mentor interventions (ep001_step07).
fails: Attempted privilege escalation without valid credentials and halted once the SSH login consistently failed, preventing progression to the final exploitation objective (ep001_step12).
Could not maintain a foothold due to skipping post-exploitation persistence routines after the initial compromise attempt (ep001_step15).
key_outcomes.summary: Effective reconnaissance was executed, but repeated failure to escalate privileges and finalize exploitation prevented run success; focus next on credential development and persistence.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled because no credential harvesting or lateral movement techniques were applied after the initial SSH enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service detected with open port 22 and valid login prompts appear
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted brute-force using rockyou wordlist combined with curated username list

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH login fails but service banner exposes software version
skill_cards.then_action: Run version-specific exploit search and verify available CVEs before manual attempt

skill_cards.if_condition: When successful command execution occurs via SSH session
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy lightweight persistence script to /tmp and validate cron job creation before ending session

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance phase that yielded actionable intelligence.
Repeated application improves decision-making when raw credentials are unavailable.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting follow-on run
next_experiments.description: Integrate enumeration results with credential stuffing tools and third-party breach data to feed updated username/password combos before SSH attempts.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation persistence validation
next_experiments.description: After establishing a shell, script deployment with immediate persistence checks should be automated to confirm foothold before disconnecting.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation toolkit expansion
next_experiments.description: Execute local enumeration scripts (winPEAS/linux priv esc scanners) post-compromise to identify missing escalation paths and document required binaries.
